title: Dynavap Hard Shell Storage Case
description:
DynaVap Storage Case
This Dynavap storage case is possibly the safest option for storing some of your Dynavap goodies. It has an extremely durable hard plastic shell and is completely air tight.
The case has foam inserts that keep everything snug. The inserts in this case are designed to hold a standard size dynastash, lighter, two small containers and the classic length M. However with a little snip and chop it can be adapted to carry XL sized Dynavaps and an XL dynastash. And also can be adapted to carry just about anything that will fit into the case itself.
Included
1 x Dynavap Storage Case
